dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Browns (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Raiders
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Todd Monken and the medical staff evaluate S Ronnie Hickman (concussion), WR Denzel Boston (toe), CB Denzel Ward (quadriceps), and DE Derek Barnett (hamstring) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Daniel Oyefusi](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4832800/denzel-boston#:~:text=Boston%20%28toe%29%20wasn't%20spotted%20at%20Wednesday's%20practice). DT Kalia Davis (quadriceps) and RB Raheim Sanders (hip) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation.

Week 12 Raiders Outlook: Todd Monken and DC Mike Rutenberg open installation for the Las Vegas Raiders (4-7, CLE -4.5, HC Klint Kubiak, OC Andrew Janocko & DC Rob Leonard (Huntington Bank Field))—a unit ranked #1 in Kickoff Return Average (29.1 yds) as Cleveland prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Jared Mueller](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-news/138950/browns-vs-raiders-week-12-injuries-denzel-boston-austin-barber-isaiah-mcguire) [Abby Mueller](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-discussion/138921/browns-home-field-advantage-could-be-on-display-on-sunday-night-football-vs-the-raiders).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (3rd in AFC North • #6 Seed in AFC), Cleveland carries a 62.8% postseason projection, 14.9% AFC North division title mark, and 0.1% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Thomas Moore](https://www.dawgsbynature.com/cleveland-browns-nfl-draft/138952/2027-browns-mock-draft-lanorris-sellers-boubacar-traore).
